left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Majors patients
  -  Score American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) 1 or 2
  -  Managed in the operating theater of the University Hospital of Saint-Etienne for a neurosurgical intervention

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Single  [OR] or bilateral eye surgery modifying the possibilities of variation of the pupillary diameter
  -  Having been asleep under general anesthesia in the 7 days prior to the current surgery
  -  History of Parkinson's disease, insulin-dependent  [OR] or non-insulin-dependent diabetes  [OR] at a dysautonomic stage or chronic alcoholism at a dysautonomous stage
